mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (indicating accommodative monetary policy) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 6.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 6.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand strength, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL above 2.0% annually), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which initially pressures equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 2.0% (YoY), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 is above its 12-month average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 (relative to 2017=100) signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS above 135.0) and a low unemployment rate (UNRATE below 6.8%) indicate a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 135.0 and UNRATE < 6.8%, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing contraction (INDPRO below 105.0), industrial output weakness pressures corporate margins and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
